sloka: एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन तस्यामात्याः समाहताः ।मारीचप्रमुखाः सर्वे विमुखा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ७.१५.२८ ॥
transliteration: evamuktāstatastena tasyāmātyāḥ samāhatāḥ ।mārīcapramukhāḥ sarve vimukhā vipradudruvuḥ ।। 7.15.28 ॥

translations.english: Thus rebuked by him, all his ministers, led by Maricha, turned their faces away and fled in all directions.
